novelty.justification: The new mechanism/measurement claim is that "a student's OWN per-token surprise under its single teacher is a sufficient proxy for the rare 'divergence tokens'" and can drive trait-agnostic training-time suppression without a contrasting teacher. The closest work is Towards Understanding Subliminal Learning: When and How Hidden Biases Transfer (2025), which already identifies rare divergence tokens, shows that masking them suppresses transmission, and implicates early layers; searches around "subliminal learning surprise divergence tokens," "single-teacher defense token surprisal," and "confidence loss reweighting distillation hidden trait transfer" also connect the proposed weighting operation to established confidence- and loss-based reweighting techniques. Moving from that work to surprise-based, single-teacher carrier approximation is a substantive new operationalization, but it is a natural extension of the prior rare-token mechanism using a standard per-token statistic and standard gradient reweighting rather than a new intervention paradigm, placing it in the 5–6 band.
